name: tradeledger
description: Personal quantitative trading, research, execution, analytics, and trading operating system.

scripts.api:build: esbuild packages/api/src/production-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/api/server.mjs --log-level=warning && node -e "console.log('API bundle written to dist/api/server.mjs')"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:glass
scripts.test:competition: vitest run tests/core/phase-6-competition.test.ts tests/application/competition-application.test.ts tests/application/competition-realtime-persistence.test.ts tests/application/competition-order-gateway.test.ts tests/api/competition-api.test.ts tests/load/competition-load.test.ts tests/load/competition-concurrency.test.ts tests/load/competition-stress.test.ts tests/load/competition-api-load.test.ts --pool=threads
